claim_en: THE FOUR WORK-COUNTS AND THEIR SUM, BY THE ENGINE'S OWN PARSER. Kohath 2,750 (4:36), Gershon 2,630 (4:40), Merari 3,200 (4:44) — summed 8,580 = 4:48's total (computed by cold_run_sequence.ink_numbers, taught the census at sitting 1b: its first proof on new ink); the dual 'thousands' = two thousand, Onkelos writing the two ('two thousand seven hundred and fifty'); against the houses from a month up (3:22, 28, 34) the working shares are 35, 32, 52 of a hundred — Merari the smallest house and the largest share, the frame-carriers (computed; no inference drawn).
middah: ink (every number computed from the ink's numerals by the engine's parser; the ratios computed)

claim_en: THE TWO SONS' PORTFOLIOS. Gershon's and Merari's service 'in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest' (4:28, 4:33 — the chapter's two Ithamars, computed) against Eleazar's charge of the holy things and the consumables (4:16, the chapter's one Eleazar): the soft and the hard under one son, the holy under the other; 7:8 repeats Ithamar over Merari's wagons; Onkelos literal ('in the hand of Ithamar').
middah: plain (the assignments read as they stand; the seats computed)

claim_en: THE CLOSING FORMULA'S ONE VARIANT. 'By the mouth of the LORD by the hand of Moses' at 4:37 (Kohath), 4:45 (Merari), 4:49 (the total) — and at 4:41 (Gershon) 'by the mouth of the LORD' WITHOUT 'by the hand of Moses' (computed on the ink); Onkelos keeps each verse's own form ('by the Word of the LORD by the hand of Moses' / 'by the Word of the LORD'). Recorded, no reason drawn; the four are the run-citations of the compile's dependency gate.
middah: ink (the four formulas computed; the absence at 4:41 measured)

claim_en: THE SERVICE OF SERVICE. 'Everyone who comes to work the service of service and the service of burden in the tent of meeting' — the doubled cognate (4:23's 'to host the host, to work the work' its twin) kept as a doubled cognate by Onkelos ('the service of service and the service of carrying'): two services named, the burden one of them; the other is the exam's — Arakhin 11a reads 'a service for another service' as the SONG (routed to the compile's docket).
middah: plain (the doubled cognate read as it stands; the second service's identity left to the exam where its teacher is)

check.note: 'the service of' — the first of the doubled cognate

claim_en: THE PRINCES JOIN THE COUNTERS. 'And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted' (4:34), 'Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel' (4:46) — the twelve of 1:4-16 stand over the Levites' work-count too (computed: the two seats, the two titles); Onkelos 'the great ones of the assembly' / 'of Israel'; 7:2 names the same men by this office — 'they who stood over the counted' — the link between the work-count and the wagons.
middah: plain (the counters named in the ink; the seats computed; the link to 7:2 by the ink's own phrase)
